request.state:
L01: A message is handed to the delivery agent once it is accepted.
L02: The agent opens one connection per destination.
L03: A connection that is refused counts as a failure.
L04: A failure is written to the delivery log with its reason.
L05: A failed delivery is tried three further times.
L06: The waits between tries are one minute, ten minutes, and one hour.
L07: A message that fails every try is moved to the held folder.
L08: The held folder is reviewed by hand each morning.
L09: A message may be released from the held folder at any time.
L10: A released message starts its tries again from the first.
L11: Nothing is ever deleted by the agent.

q1.instructions: Which line gives how many times a failed delivery is tried again?
